entries.name: GZC8072
entries.stage: Recruiting China Phase 1; sponsor-described once-weekly oral peptide GLP-1 RA; no posted results
entries.summary: Gan & Lee describes GZC8072 as an investigational ultra-long-acting oral peptide GLP-1 receptor agonist designed for once-weekly administration. The sponsor-submitted NCT07784699 record studies a single oral dose in healthy adults and multiple oral doses in adults with overweight or obesity. It records recruiting Phase 1 research in China, an actual 2 September 2026 start and 126 estimated participants.
entries.ukAuthorisation: The reviewed evidence does not establish UK marketing authorisation for GZC8072. China's NMPA permission to conduct clinical trials is not a marketing authorisation in China or the UK.
entries.nhsEngland: No NICE recommendation or NHS England access is established by the reviewed research evidence.
entries.supply: A recruiting Chinese clinical trial and permission to investigate the medicine do not establish lawful UK retail supply, pharmacy stock or sale by Shift Some Timber.
entries.limitations: This promotes a candidate explicitly deferred on 3 October after the later primary record confirmed an initiated obesity study; it is not a newly started October trial. The Phase 1 study primarily evaluates safety, tolerability, immunogenicity and pharmacokinetics; fasting weight, BMI and waist circumference are secondary outcomes. The registry has no posted results, so it does not establish weight-loss efficacy, a weekly regimen's benefit, long-term safety or superiority. Gan & Lee's 9 September first-participant release planned 112 participants, while the registry updated 30 September estimates 126; the later registry figure is used without treating either estimate as actual enrolment. August 2027 completion remains estimated. The reviewed evidence is China-based and does not establish UK authorisation, NICE/NHS access or UK supply.
